_comment: Operational config for job_search.py and match_scorer.py. Commit this file — it contains no personal data. Edit search_queries and title_filter_terms for your target role.

apify_settings.note: vc_portfolio_keyword narrows the VC portfolio scraper. wellfound_roles must match Wellfound's URL slug format (e.g. 'product-manager', 'data-engineer').

scorer_settings.note: Set provider to 'anthropic', 'openai', or 'zhipuai'. Model must match the provider (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6 for Anthropic, glm-5.2 for ZhipuAI).
